newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil may delay CVRD auction - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil may delay CVRD auction - paper.

text.p: The privatization auction of Brazilian state mining concern Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), scheduled for April 29, may be delayed, O Globo newspaper said on Tuesday.

Jose Pio Borges, vice-president of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), acknowledged that many lawsuits against Vale's sell-off were filed and some of them might succeed in suspending the auction, the newspaper said.
However, Pio Borges noted that BNDES, which handles most of Brazil's privatizations, has enough experience in facing this kind of judicial battle, O Globo added.
"If there are delays, they will be temporary," Pio Borges was quoted as saying.

Pio Borges made these comments amid demonstrations against Vale's privatization in the city of Ouro Preto, Minas Gerais state, the newspaper said. About 1,000 people, including Vale's employees and union representatives, protested against the company's sale.
Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said Brazil's Supreme Court is likely to begin ruling on lawsuits against Vale's sell-off in coming days.
So far some 70 lawsuits have been filed, press reports said.
